title: The Listening Bell
author: Coral Ravensworth
blurb: Freya Underhill, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
